description: Work with Sprinklr, the enterprise platform for social media and customer care: open, update and find cases, add notes, read and search messages and conversations, reply to customers, schedule posts, and pull the data behind your dashboards. Start a workflow when a case is opened or changes status, a message comes in, or a post goes out.

sprinklr_case_status_changed_trigger.description: Runs when a case's status changes in Sprinklr, such as from Open to Closed, with the case as it is now. A case changed for the first time since the workflow was turned on runs it too.

output.assignee_id: The ID of the user (or bot) it is assigned to
output.brand_message_count: How many messages your brand sent
output.case_number: The case number people see in Sprinklr, like 120337901
output.case_type: Its type, such as Complaint or Question
output.contact_channel_id: The customer's ID on that channel
output.contact_channel_type: How the customer reached you, such as EMAIL or INSTAGRAM
output.contact_id: The customer's profile ID, such as SMS_+14155550123
output.contact_name: The customer's name, if Sprinklr knows it
output.conversation_id: The conversation the first message belongs to
output.custom_properties: Its custom fields, by field name, each a list of values
output.customer_message_count: How many messages the customer sent
output.due_date: When it is due (ISO 8601, UTC), empty if not set
output.external_case_id: The linked case's ID in another system, such as Salesforce
output.external_system: Which system the linked case is in, such as SALESFORCE
output.first_message_id: The ID of the first message on the case
output.latest_message_id: The ID of the newest message on the case
output.sentiment: Sprinklr's sentiment score for the case
output.status: Its status, such as New, Open or Closed
output.subject: The case's subject (Sprinklr puts the case number in front)
output.summary: The case summary an agent wrote
output.version: Goes up by one each time the case changes

parameters.description: Only when it changes to this status, as your Sprinklr names it, such as Closed. Leave blank for any status.
parameters.name: status

sprinklr_new_message_trigger.description: Runs when a customer's message, comment, mention, email or chat reaches one of your accounts in Sprinklr, with what it says, who sent it and the case it is on.

output.account_id: The ID of your account it came in on or went out from
output.account_type: The kind of account, such as SOCIAL or MESSAGING
output.attachment_url: A link to its picture, video or file, if any
output.case_number: The case it is on, if any
output.channel_created_time: When it was sent on the channel (ISO 8601, UTC)
output.channel_message_id: The message's ID on the social network
output.channel_type: The channel, such as FACEBOOK, TWITTER or EMAIL
output.from_brand: True when your brand sent it, false when a customer did

output.permalink: A link to it on the social network

output.sender_channel_id: The sender's ID on the channel
output.sender_username: The sender's username on the channel
output.source_type: Where Sprinklr got it, such as ACCOUNT or LISTENING
output.title: Its title or email subject, if any
